quotes.text: Elijah the Prophet, in this verse, calls upon the children of Israel to come to a speedy decision upon a very important point. They had been half-hearted too long. He therefore gave them the means of testing the power of their Baal and his Jehovah. The result showed them how powerless was Baal and how mighty was the Lord of hosts. This at once decided them, and they thenceforth worshipped the God…
